verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖۤ اَنْ اَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: ﻿inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum 'athabun aleemun
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily We sent Noah to his people [saying]: ‘Warn your people before there come on them — should they not believe — a painful chastisement’, in this world and in the Hereafter.

verses.uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.indopak: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اِنِّىْ لَـكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌۙ
verses.transliteration: qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
verses.khattab: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘O my people, I am indeed a plain warner to you, one whose warning is plain,

verses.uthmani: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.indopak: اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوْهُ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِۙ
verses.transliteration: ani o'budoo allaha waittaqoohu waatee'ooni
verses.saheeh: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
verses.khattab: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[to tell you] that [you should] worship God and fear Him and obey me,

verses.uthmani: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚلَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: يَغْفِرْ لَـكُمْ مِّنْ ذُنُوْبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَاۤءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘلَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum ta'lamoona
verses.saheeh: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
verses.khattab: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that He may forgive you some of your sins (min dhunūbikum, ‘some of your sins’: min may be taken as extra, because submission to God (islām) expunges everything [of sin that was committed] previous to it; or it [min] may be understood as partitive, to point out that which is due to [those who were already God’s] servants) and defer you, without chastising [you], until an appointed term, the term for death. Indeed when God’s term, for your chastisement — should you not believe — comes, it cannot be deferred, if only you knew’, this, you would believe.

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلٗا وَنَهَارٗا
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِىْ لَيْلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee laylan wanaharan
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
verses.khattab: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘My Lord, I have summoned my people night and day, that is to say, continuously without interruption,

verses.uthmani: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا
verses.indopak: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاۤءِىْۤ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.transliteration: falam yazidhum du'aee illa firaran
verses.saheeh: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
verses.khattab: but my calls only made them run farther away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but my summon has only increased their evasion, of faith.

verses.uthmani: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا
verses.indopak: وَاِنِّىْ كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا اَصَابِعَهُمْ فِىْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَاَصَرُّوْا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًاۚ
verses.transliteration: wainnee kullama da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'aloo asabi'ahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran
verses.saheeh: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
verses.khattab: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed whenever I summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, in order not to hear what I say, and draw their cloaks over themselves, they cover their heads with them in order not to catch sight of me, and they persist, in their disbelief, and act in great arrogance, disdaining faith.

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارٗا
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اِنِّىْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًاۙ
verses.transliteration: thumma innee da'awtuhum jiharan
verses.saheeh: Then I invited them publicly.
verses.khattab: Then I certainly called them openly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then indeed I summoned them aloud, that is to say, at the top of my voice;

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارٗا
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اِنِّىْۤ اَعْلَـنْتُ لَهُمْ وَاَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ اِسْرَارًاۙ
verses.transliteration: thumma innee a'lantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran
verses.saheeh: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
verses.khattab: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then assuredly I proclaimed to them, with my voice, and I confided, my words, to them secretly,

verses.uthmani: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا
verses.indopak: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْۗاِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ
verses.transliteration: faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
verses.saheeh: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.khattab: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
verses.jalalayn: ﻿saying, “Ask your Lord for forgiveness, from idolatry. Assuredly He is ever Forgiving.

verses.uthmani: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا
verses.indopak: يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۤءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًاۙ
verses.transliteration: yursili alssamaa 'alaykum midraran
verses.saheeh: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
verses.khattab: He will shower you with abundant rain
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He will release the heaven, the rain — for they had been deprived of it — for you in torrents, in plenteous showers,

verses.uthmani: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا
verses.indopak: وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّـكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّـكُمْ اَنْهٰرًاۗ
verses.transliteration: wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayaj'al lakum jannatin wayaj'al lakum anharan
verses.saheeh: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
verses.khattab: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and furnish you with wealth and sons, and assign to you gardens, orchards, and assign to you, running, rivers.

verses.uthmani: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارٗا
verses.indopak: مَا لَـكُمْ لَا تَرْجُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ
verses.transliteration: ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran
verses.saheeh: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
verses.khattab: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What is wrong with you that you do not hope for dignity from God, that is to say, [that] you [do not] hope that God will dignify you by becoming believers,

verses.uthmani: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
verses.indopak: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ اَطْوَارًا
verses.transliteration: waqad khalaqakum atwaran
verses.saheeh: While He has created you in stages?
verses.khattab: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when verily He created you in stages? (atwār is the plural of tūr, which means a state). Thus the sperm-drop is one state, the blood clot is another state, and so on, until the creation of the human being is complete: reflecting on [the manner of] his creation necessarily leads to belief in his Creator.

verses.uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا
verses.indopak: اَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ
verses.transliteration: alam taraw kayfa khalaqa allahu sab'a samawatin tibaqan
verses.saheeh: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
verses.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have you not seen how God created seven heavens in layers, one on top of the other,

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا
verses.indopak: وَّجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيْهِنَّ نُوْرًاۙوَّجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.transliteration: waja'ala alqamara feehinna nooran waja'ala alshshamsa sirajan
verses.saheeh: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
verses.khattab: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and made the moon therein — that is to say, within their totality, [but] which is [effectively] true in the case of the heaven of this world — as a light and made the sun as a lamp?, as an illuminating lantern, more powerful than the light of the moon.

verses.uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتٗا
verses.indopak: وَاللّٰهُ اَنْۢبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ نَبَاتًاۙ
verses.transliteration: waallahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan
verses.saheeh: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
verses.khattab: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And God has caused you to grow, He has created you, from the earth, for He created your father Adam from it.

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجٗا
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُكُمْ فِيْهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ اِخْرَاجًا
verses.transliteration: thumma yu'eedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan
verses.saheeh: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
verses.khattab: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then He will make you return into it, entombed [in your graves], and bring you forth, for the resurrection, [with a veritable bringing forth].

verses.uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطٗا
verses.indopak: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الْاَرْضَ بِسَاطًاۙ
verses.transliteration: waallahu ja'ala lakumu alarda bisatan
verses.saheeh: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
verses.khattab: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And God has made the earth a flat [open] expanse for you,

verses.uthmani: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلٗا فِجَاجٗا
verses.indopak: لِّـتَسْلُكُوْا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا٪
verses.transliteration: litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan
verses.saheeh: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
verses.khattab: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that you may follow throughout it spacious routes.” ’

verses.uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا
verses.indopak: قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِىْ وَاتَّبَعُوْا مَنْ لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗۤ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ
verses.transliteration: qala noohun rabbi innahum 'asawnee waittaba'oo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran
verses.saheeh: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
verses.khattab: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed, that is, the riffraff and the paupers [among them have followed], those whose wealth and children, namely, their leaders who have been blessed with such things (read wulduhu or waladuhu, ‘whose children’, the first of which is said to be the plural of walad, similar [in pattern] to khasab, khushb, or in fact [it is said to be] of the same meaning [as walad, but an alternative form] as in the case of bukhl or bakhal, ‘niggardliness’), only add to their loss, [to] their insolence and disbelief.

verses.uthmani: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا كُبَّارٗا
verses.indopak: وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًاۚ
verses.transliteration: wamakaroo makran kubbaran
verses.saheeh: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
verses.khattab: and who have devised a tremendous plot
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they have devised, namely, the leaders, a mighty plot, extremely outrageous, by denying Noah and harming him as well as his followers,

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا
verses.indopak: وَ قَالُوْا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًاۙوَّ لَا يَغُوْثَ وَيَعُوْقَ وَنَسْرًاۚ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwa'an wala yaghootha waya'ooqa wanasran
verses.saheeh: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
verses.khattab: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and have said, to the riffraff: “Do not abandon your gods, and do not abandon Wadd (read Wadd or Wudd) nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr” — these being the names of their idols.

verses.uthmani: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖوَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا
verses.indopak: وَقَدْ اَضَلُّوْا كَثِيْرًاۚوَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
verses.transliteration: waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan
verses.saheeh: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
verses.khattab: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they have certainly led astray, by these [gods], many, people, by commanding them to worship them. And do not [O God] increase the evildoers except in error!’ (wa-lā tazidi’l-zālimīna illā dalālan is a supplement to qad adallū, ‘they have certainly led astray’): He [Noah] invoked God against them when it was revealed to him that, ‘None of your people will believe except he who has already believed’ [Q. 11:36].

verses.uthmani: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا
verses.indopak: مِّمَّا خَطِيْۤئٰتِهِمْ اُغْرِقُوْا فَاُدْخِلُوْا نَارًاۙفَلَمْ يَجِدُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَنْصَارًا
verses.transliteration: mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni allahi ansaran
verses.saheeh: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
verses.khattab: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Because of (mimmā: mā indicates a relative clause) their iniquities (khatāyāhum: a variant reading has khatī’ātihim) they were drowned, by the Flood, then made to enter the Fire, with which they were punished underwater after drowning. And they did not find for themselves besides, that is to say, other than, God any helpers, to protect them against the chastisement.

verses.uthmani: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.indopak: وَ قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ دَيَّارًا
verses.transliteration: waqala noohun rabbi la tathar 'ala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran
verses.saheeh: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
verses.khattab: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Noah said, ‘My Lord, do not leave from among the disbelievers a single dweller upon the earth (dayyār means ‘one who inhabits a dwelling [dār]’), in other words, not one.

verses.uthmani: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا
verses.indopak: اِنَّكَ اِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْۤا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.transliteration: innaka in tatharhum yudilloo 'ibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.khattab: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly if You leave them, they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget only disbelieving profligates (fājir and kaffār derive [respectively] from yafjuru and yakfuru): he said this on account of the mentioned revelation that had been given to him.

verses.uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖوَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
verses.indopak: رَبِّ اغْفِرْلِىْ وَلِـوَالِدَىَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَّلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِۗوَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا٪
verses.transliteration: rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
verses.saheeh: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
verses.khattab: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My Lord, forgive me and my parents — both of whom were believers — and whoever enters my house, my dwelling or my place of worship, as a believer, and believing men and believing women, to the Day of Resurrection, and do not increase the evildoers except in ruin’, in destruction — and thus they were destroyed.
